item.description: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into social simulation has generated considerable enthusiasm, but also raises substantial methodological and epistemological challenges. item.title: AgentMesh: Toward Redundancy- and Barrier-Free Dataflow in Multi-Agent Systems
item.description: Multi-agent systems (MAS) now power long-running agentic applications like deep research and coding agents, yet their end-to-end latency reaches minutes to hours. item.description: Financial multi-agent systems distribute evidence extraction, expectation retrieval, consistency checking, decision, and settlement across roles. item.description: Contemporary global value networks and capital-intensive infrastructure projects face an existential crisis driven by geopolitical disruptions, persistent inflation, and the fragile leverage of conventional interest-based debt. item.title: The design and impact of a dual-agent artificial intelligence system in personalised mathematics tutoring
item.description: Digital tutoring tools are increasingly used in schools to support mathematics learning, but empirical evidence remains limited on how diagnostic and instructional functions can be coordinated to provide personalised support. item.title: Delegating or Doing? Understanding User Behavior in Hybrid Human–Agent Interfaces
item.description: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly embedded into applications, allowing users to complete tasks either through direct manipulation or by delegating actions to conversational agents. item.description: Electrified agricultural machinery increasingly relies on permanent-magnet synchronous motor drives that must remain dependable under variable traction, terrain-induced vibration, thermal cycling, contamination, and intermittent duty. item.description: Recent research has established that generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is not a unitary workplace resource: exploratory and exploitative use orientations are associated with different forms of employee creativity, and their value depends on employees' capacity to integrate generated knowledge. item.title: Post-traumatic stress disorder: pathogenesis, epidemiological characteristics, animal models, and potential therapeutic strategies
item.description: Post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) is a complex neurobehavioral disorder that disproportionately affects military service members. The clinical presentation of PTSD is heterogeneous and may overlap with other psychiatric conditions. item.title: Can TDD improve the quality of LLM-migrated code? : A pilot study in an industrial context
item.description: The emergence of Large Language Models (LLM) has created new possibilities for automating software development, yet ensuring the quality of AI-generated code remains a major challenge. item.title: From Coding to Creativity: Integrating Design Thinking into IT and Technology Education
item.description: This study examines how the integration of Design Thinking into Information Technology (IT) and technology education can bridge technical programming skills and creative, human-centered problem-solving.
